capabilities: Color files in the file explorer using tag-to-color rules
Apply text, background, or colored-dot coloring methods
Prioritize which tag's rule wins when a file has several tagged colors
Color file names in Bases table and list views
Export and import rules as a backup (desktop only)
disambiguation: Not a tag-styling tool; it colors the files in the explorer based on their tags, not the tags themselves in note text.
extras: Rule backup export is desktop-only due to mobile platform limitations. The plugin listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Files are colored in the Obsidian file explorer according to the tag-color rules that you create.
motivation: The author tagged quotes while reading literature (e.g. #key-idea, #disagree) and wanted those notes visible in the explorer without filtering by tag.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no visual indication of which tags a note has, so finding tagged notes means filtering through search or the tag pane.

relations.evidence: If you want to test beta-versions of the plugin or use previous versions, you can do that with BRAT plugin

summary: Colors files in the file explorer automatically based on the tags they contain, using tag-to-color rules defined in the settings.
